_rationale: Start $1.5M. path[i] = beginning-of-year balance; black swan multiplies first, then the year's net flow. 2025 (idx0): +50k consulting - 60k living - 10k vacation = -20k -> 1,480,000. 2026: -10k -> 1,470,000. 2027: x0.76 (stock 0.6 on 60/40) = 1,117,200, then -10k -> 1,107,200 at idx3 (2028). 2028-2031: -60k/yr -> 867,200 at idx7 (2032). 2032-2033: self SS 30k so -30k/yr -> 807,200 at idx9 (2034). 2034+: both SS (50k) so -10k/yr -> 797,200 at idx10, then 797,200 - 10k x (idx-10); idx30 (2055, age 90) = 597,200. Total tax is zero in every year (after-tax income, 0% LTCG, SS taxable fraction stays under the MFJ standard deduction, FL/TX no income tax, IRMAA/NIIT off). The twin file stale-plan-2026-twin.json is this same plan re-expressed in the 2026 frame; its path for a given calendar year differs from this one by exactly the un-rolled 2025 net flow (-20k x 0.76 after the 2027 shock = -15,200) because balances are carried as saved, not projected forward.
